schema.description: Request schema for updating a form.

description.description: Optional help text displayed below the field.

id.description: Unique identifier for the field. Optional on create; include to reference an existing field on update.

key.description: Machine-readable key for the field. Must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores.

must_be_true.description: For boolean fields, whether the value must be true (e.g., consent checkboxes).

oneOf.description: Options for choice-type fields (select, radio, checkbox).

allow_other.description: Whether to allow a free-text 'other' option.

items.description: A choice option for a select, radio, or checkbox field. The id is optional on input; the server generates one if omitted.

id.description: Unique identifier for the choice. Optional on create; include to reference an existing choice on update.

items.title: FieldChoiceInput

oneOf.title: FieldOptionsInput

position.description: Display position of the field within the form.

sensitive.description: Whether the field contains sensitive data.

schema.title: UpdateFormRequest
